requiredFieldError.description: Field-level 'Required' validation message shown under an empty mandatory field. MUST stay CSS-scoped to the error-message class, not a text match — this form also has an unrelated '* Required' legend at the bottom whose text contains the substring 'Required', which a non-exact text-strategy match (this repo's TextStrategy always uses exact:false) would incorrectly count alongside the real 2 field errors. Confirmed live: this caused an unstable count varying 1-3 across runs before the fix.
